scope: isolated local macOS native QA; metadata-only evidence; no production change
question: After preserving explicit skill metadata for AskForCardChosen, do multiple mixed native full matches remain free of invalid replies and malformed chooser-prompt classification?

sourceChanges.purpose: Keep skill_name as explicit AskForCardChosen metadata beside the display prompt.
Prefer explicit skill metadata and retain the legacy prompt parser fallback.
Keep the isolated QA dispatcher aligned with the public SmartAI adapter.

askForCardChosen.interpretation: Chooser requests without a bounded strategy now use an explicit safe no_strategy fallback; no request was classified as malformed_prompt or invalid.

verification.runnerEvidence: All four corrected wrappers reported RUNNER_EXIT=0; each log emitted client/bot audit and GameOver/result PASS lines.
verification.identityEvidence: All four runner logs reported the same public runtime MD5 01dc027eaa8c8171fc5e4c1e8afc6f50 and the same QA package identity.
verification.requestSafetyEvidence: All four sanitized AI_MATCH_METRICS records had invalid=0 and all AskForCardChosen command records had malformed_prompt=0.
verification.cleanupEvidence: After the matrix, native and gateway processes were stopped, QA symlinks were removed from the temp runtime, and ports 19647/9000 had no listeners.

excludedAttempts.reason: An earlier temp run used a pending symlink that still resolved to qa_packages, so its runtime MD5 included the QA tree; it is excluded from this matrix.
Two shell preflight attempts omitted a scenario or used a missing temp log path; they opened no native gameplay and contribute no metrics.

limitations: These are four candidate trajectories, not a matched baseline/candidate experiment and not a full 18-skill opportunity denominator.
Fallback/no_decision remains substantial; zero invalid replies and zero malformed chooser prompts are bounded request-safety evidence, not tactical-quality, downstream-effect or win-rate proof.
Per-skill provenance covers only 13 allowlisted requests across three observed skills; missing attribution is not assigned to any skill.
No reconnect/device, release/rollback, canary or production evidence is included. REQUEST_SAFETY_OPEN remains open and production remains NO-GO.
No raw logs, credentials, prompts, card/target IDs, private hands/generals or exception payloads are stored in this artifact.
